data.one_liner: A password strength estimator for Dart and Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Estimates password strength based on length, character types, and checks against the top 10,000 most used passwords. Returns a double value representing the estimated strength.
use_when: You need to show users if their chosen password is weak or strong against brute-force attacks.
You want a simple utility function to evaluate password security in forms.
avoid_when: You require advanced enterprise-grade policy enforcement with custom rules and regex requirements.
You need async remote database checks for compromised credentials.
strengths: Very simple and straightforward API with a single estimation function.
Built-in dictionary check against top 10,000 most used passwords.
Supports null-safety and runs across all platforms.
weaknesses: Very basic feature set with no customizable rule engine.
Dictionary checks are limited to the hardcoded top 10,000 list.
